تنتظروا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَظِرُوا (tantaẓirū) /tan.ta.ðˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَظَرَ (intaẓara)
# تُنْتَظَرُوا (tuntaẓarū) /tun.ta.ðˤa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَظَرَ (intaẓara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
